_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as pushup_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.
labelingGuidance: Standard side-view floor push-ups are the target scope for Push-Up labels.
Mark each rep view accurately; use scorable=false when the view, full body, or form-critical landmarks are not judgeable.
Count meaningful shallow or partial attempts as reps when there is clear descent and return.
Use push-up.depth_short or push-up.lockout_short for endpoint-specific range-of-motion failures.
Use push-up.incomplete_rom only as the fallback ROM issue when neither endpoint issue is the clearer label.
Label only visible faults; do not treat unobservable cues as clean negatives.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Go deeper — aim for elbows at 90 degrees.
Lock out your arms fully at the top.
Incomplete rep — full range of motion from lockout to 90 degrees.
Hips are sagging — engage your core to maintain a straight line.
Hips are piking up — lower them to maintain a straight plank.
Keep your head neutral — align your neck with your spine.
Slow down the push — control the movement.
Control the descent — don't drop into the pushup.
Stack your shoulders over your hands.
Set the camera side-on with your full body in frame.
